items.title: Rudd-era mining tax could have boosted budget by $135b
items.summary: Labor's abandoned mining tax, which led to the 2010 toppling of Kevin Rudd, could have improved the budget by $135 billion, a Parliamentary Budget Office analysis finds.

items.title: Coles investigates cyber attack but provides little detail
items.summary: Coles has told customers to "remain vigilant" as it investigates a cyber incident, but says it has not identified customer or employee data being compromised at this stage.

aus.headline: Mining Tax's $135b What-If
aus.body: Budget analysts say Labor's scrapped mining tax could have lifted the budget by $135b.
aus.why: Shows how much revenue a resources tax might have raised.

us.headline: AI Curbs Sink Wall Street
us.body: US stocks fell as big tech slid on plans to curb access to advanced AI infrastructure.
us.why: Big US tech moves can sway global share markets.

biz.headline: Coles Probes Cyber Attack
biz.body: Coles is looking into a cyber incident but says no customer data appears hit so far.
biz.why: Coles shoppers are being told to stay alert.
